title: Zesty Smoky Spanish Celery Fabada Asturiana
description: A smoky and indulgent Spanish dish featuring celery, with a spicy kick, halal-friendly and made in the style of fabada asturiana. This recipe combines the flavors of Spain with a unique twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and drained fabes beans, chopped celery, and halal Spanish chorizo to the pot.
Stir in the tomato paste and add enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve the fabada asturiana hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
